designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Deep Fork National Wildlife Refuge to protect bottomland hardwood forest along the Deep Fork River.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Deep Fork National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Deep Fork National Wildlife Refuge Integrated Pest Management Plan (ServCat 175315): "Deep Fork NWR was established in 1993 to protect the remaining bottomland hardwood forests along the Deep Fork River"

review.note: Draft sentence described the National Trails System Act (1968). Refuge: 1993 (CCP). Authority not confirmed.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: National Recreation Trails were established by the National Trails System Act of 1968 (Public Law 90-543), which authorized creation of a national trails system composed of National Recreation Trails, National Scenic Trails and National Historic Trails.
